warum: Your activity is a trade (Gewerbe).

gruendung.krankenversicherung|einmalig.titel: Tell your health insurance about your self-employment
gruendung.krankenversicherung|einmalig.kurz: Tell your health insurance that you are self-employed. If self-employment is your main occupation, you insure yourself.

sanktion.text: The consequences have not yet been reviewed by experts.

gruendung.krankenversicherung|einmalig.erklaerung: Becoming self-employed can change your health insurance. If self-employment is your main occupation, you take care of your own insurance and contributions.

gruendung.rundfunkbeitrag|einmalig.titel: Register your business premises for the broadcasting fee
gruendung.rundfunkbeitrag|einmalig.kurz: Register your business premises with the Beitragsservice for the broadcasting fee (Rundfunkbeitrag).

sanktion.text: The consequences have not yet been reviewed by experts.

zu_klaeren: You have at least one business premises.
gruendung.rundfunkbeitrag|einmalig.erklaerung: The broadcasting fee (Rundfunkbeitrag) applies to business premises. You register with the Beitragsservice.

label.en: You have at least one business premises.

sanktion.text: Not an obligation. Without clarification, the risk remains that you will later be classified as an employee.

zu_klaeren: You mainly work for one client.
gruendung.statusfeststellung|einmalig.erklaerung: The status determination is an option, not an obligation. It gives you certainty if there is a risk of bogus self-employment.

begriffe.erklaerung: When someone is formally self-employed but actually works like an employee.

gruendung.statusfeststellung|einmalig.stelle: German Pension Insurance (Deutsche Rentenversicherung), clearing office (Clearingstelle)

label.de: Du arbeitest überwiegend für einen Auftraggeber.
label.en: You mainly work for one client.

gruendung.ust_idnr|einmalig.titel: Apply for a VAT identification number
gruendung.ust_idnr|einmalig.kurz: If you do business with customers in other EU countries, you apply for a VAT ID number (USt-IdNr.) from the Federal Central Tax Office (Bundeszentralamt für Steuern).

sanktion.text: The consequences have not yet been reviewed by experts.

zu_klaeren: You have customers in other EU countries.
gruendung.ust_idnr|einmalig.erklaerung: You need the VAT identification number for business within the EU.

label.de: Du hast Kunden in anderen EU-Ländern.
label.en: You have customers in other EU countries.

it_sicherheit.nis2_meldepflichten|einmal.kurz: You report significant security incidents to the BSI in fixed stages and deadlines.

sanktion.text: Fines of up to €10 million or 2% of revenue are possible.

zu_klaeren: Your company falls under NIS2.
it_sicherheit.nis2_meldepflichten|einmal.erklaerung: If NIS2 applies to you, you must report significant security incidents and implement risk management measures. Management is liable for implementation.

label.en: Your company falls under NIS2.

it_sicherheit.nis2_pruefen|einmalig.kurz: Find out whether your company falls under the NIS2 rules based on sector and size.

sanktion.text: Without this clarification, it remains unclear whether registration and reporting obligations apply.

warum: You have not yet stated whether NIS2 applies to you.
it_sicherheit.nis2_pruefen|einmalig.erklaerung: NIS2 affects companies in certain sectors above a certain size. If you are affected, you must register with the BSI and report security incidents. Answer the question in your profile as soon as you know.

label.de: Du hast noch nicht angegeben, ob NIS2 für dich gilt.

ki.kompetenz|einmalig.kurz: Anyone in your company who works with AI needs sufficient AI literacy: provide training and keep a record of it.

begriffe.erklaerung: Knowledge and skills to use AI systems competently and to understand their opportunities and risks.

You offer your own AI products.

online.barrierefreiheit|einmalig.stelle: Market surveillance authorities of the federal states

online.button_loesung|einmalig.kurz: The button consumers use to place a paid order must clearly indicate the obligation to pay.

sanktion.text: The consequences have not yet been reviewed by experts.

zu_klaeren: You sell to consumers.
You sell via an online shop or an app.
online.button_loesung|einmalig.erklaerung: Under § 312j BGB, no valid contract is concluded without clear labelling.

online.cookie_einwilligung|einmalig.titel: Get consent for cookies and tracking
online.cookie_einwilligung|einmalig.kurz: If your website uses tracking or non-essential cookies, you get visitors' consent first.

sanktion.text: The consequences have not yet been reviewed by experts.

zu_klaeren: Your website uses tracking.
online.cookie_einwilligung|einmalig.erklaerung: Under § 25 TDDDG, storing and reading information on a user's device generally requires consent unless it is strictly necessary. The consent check for your website will follow with the online check (section 7).

label.en: Your website uses tracking.

online.dac7|einmalig.titel: Understand platform reports to the tax office (DAC7)
online.dac7|einmalig.kurz: Marketplaces report sellers and sales to the Federal Central Tax Office (Bundeszentralamt für Steuern); the information in your tax return should match.

sanktion.text: No obligation of your own; explanation of the platform reports.

zu_klaeren: You sell via online marketplaces.
online.dac7|einmalig.erklaerung: Under the Platform Tax Transparency Act (Plattformen-Steuertransparenzgesetz, DAC7), platforms report certain sellers. Amtlos explains what is reported.

label.en: You sell via online marketplaces.

online.datenschutzerklaerung|einmalig.kurz: On your website, you provide a privacy policy (Datenschutzerklärung) explaining how data is processed.

sanktion.text: The consequences have not yet been reviewed by experts.

warum: You have a website.
online.datenschutzerklaerung|einmalig.erklaerung: The privacy policy must be reachable from every page. Its content follows the GDPR information obligations (catalogue F).

label.en: You have a website.

label.de: Du verkaufst über einen Onlineshop oder eine App.
label.en: You sell via an online shop or an app.

online.impressum|einmalig.kurz: On your website, you provide a legal notice (Impressum) with the mandatory information, easy to find and always accessible.

sanktion.text: The consequences have not yet been reviewed by experts.

warum: You have a website.
online.impressum|einmalig.erklaerung: The legal notice includes, among other things, name, address and contact details, and for companies also the legal representatives and register details. The online check verifies that it is linked.

label.en: You have a website.

label.de: Du verkaufst über einen Onlineshop oder eine App.
label.en: You sell via an online shop or an app.

online.kuendigungsbutton|einmalig.kurz: If consumers can take out subscriptions on your website, you need a cancellation button.

sanktion.text: The consequences have not yet been reviewed by experts.

zu_klaeren: You sell to consumers.
You offer subscriptions.
online.kuendigungsbutton|einmalig.erklaerung: § 312k BGB requires an easy way to cancel via the website for continuing obligations that can be concluded online.

label.en: You sell to consumers.
You offer subscriptions.

online.marktplatz_angaben|einmalig.kurz: On online marketplaces, you provide your full seller information.

sanktion.text: The consequences have not yet been reviewed by experts.

zu_klaeren: You sell via online marketplaces.
online.marktplatz_angaben|einmalig.erklaerung: Marketplaces ask for information about your business and show it to customers; much of it is required by law.

label.en: You sell via online marketplaces.

online.os_link|einmalig.titel: Check the link to the ODR platform
online.os_link|einmalig.kurz: Check whether the former link to the EU online dispute resolution platform on your website is still up to date.

sanktion.text: The consequences have not yet been reviewed by experts.

zu_klaeren: You sell to consumers.
You sell via an online shop or an app.
online.os_link|einmalig.erklaerung: The specification requires checking the status of the former ODR platform link and keeping it up to date. The online check reports whether the link is on your website.

label.en: You sell to consumers.

label.de: Du verkaufst über einen Onlineshop oder eine App.
label.en: You sell via an online shop or an app.

online.preisangaben|einmalig.kurz: To consumers, you state total prices, and for goods sold by weight, volume or length also the unit price.

sanktion.text: The consequences have not yet been reviewed by experts.

zu_klaeren: You sell to consumers.
online.preisangaben|einmalig.erklaerung: The Price Indication Ordinance (Preisangabenverordnung) governs how prices must be stated to consumers.

label.en: You sell to consumers.

online.widerrufsbelehrung|einmalig.titel: Inform customers about the right of withdrawal
online.widerrufsbelehrung|einmalig.kurz: For distance contracts with consumers, you inform them about the right of withdrawal.

sanktion.text: The consequences have not yet been reviewed by experts.

zu_klaeren: You sell to consumers.
You conclude contracts online or via an app.
online.widerrufsbelehrung|einmalig.erklaerung: Consumers usually have a right of withdrawal for distance contracts, which you must inform them about before the contract is concluded.

label.en: You sell to consumers.

label.de: Du schließt Verträge online oder per App.
label.en: You conclude contracts online or via an app.

online.widerrufsbutton|einmalig.kurz: Since 19.6.2026, B2C online contracts with a right of withdrawal need a withdrawal button: two-step, without login, with confirmation of receipt on a durable medium.

sanktion.text: The consequences have not yet been reviewed by experts.

zu_klaeren: You sell to consumers.
You conclude contracts online or via an app.
online.widerrufsbutton|einmalig.erklaerung: Consumers must be able to declare withdrawal online as easily as concluding the contract.

label.en: You sell to consumers.

label.de: Du schließt Verträge online oder per App.
label.en: You conclude contracts online or via an app.

personal.anmeldezeitraum_angeben|einmali.titel: Enter the payroll tax filing period
personal.anmeldezeitraum_angeben|einmali.kurz: So that Amtlos can calculate the dates for the payroll tax return (Lohnsteuer-Anmeldung), you need the filing period.

sanktion.text: Without the filing period, Amtlos cannot calculate any dates.

warum: You employ at least one person.
The filing period is still missing.
personal.anmeldezeitraum_angeben|einmali.erklaerung: The tax office (Finanzamt) tells you the filing period. You can find it in your payroll tax documents or ask your tax adviser.

label.en: You employ at least one person.
The filing period is still missing.

personal.arbeitszeit_aufzeichnung|einmal.kurz: You record your employees' working hours.

sanktion.text: The consequences have not yet been reviewed by experts.

warum: You employ at least one person.
personal.arbeitszeit_aufzeichnung|einmal.erklaerung: According to rulings of the Federal Labour Court (Bundesarbeitsgericht), there is already an obligation to record working time. Amtlos offers time tracking that is prepared for the planned new rules.

label.en: You employ at least one person.

personal.arbeitszeit_milog|einmalig.kurz: For mini-jobbers and in industries with immediate reporting obligations, you must record the start, end and duration of working time.

sanktion.text: The consequences have not yet been reviewed by experts.

warum: You employ at least one person.
You employ mini-jobbers.
personal.arbeitszeit_milog|einmalig.erklaerung: § 17 MiLoG requires records for marginally employed persons and for employees in industries with an immediate reporting obligation (Sofortmeldepflicht).

label.en: You employ at least one person.
You employ mini-jobbers.

label.de: Dein Betrieb gehört zu einer Branche mit Sofortmeldepflicht.

personal.aushangpflichtige_gesetze|einma.titel: Post the laws that must be displayed
personal.aushangpflichtige_gesetze|einma.kurz: Depending on your workforce, you display certain laws at your workplace, for example ArbZG, AGG, MuSchG and JArbSchG.

sanktion.text: The consequences have not yet been reviewed by experts.

warum: You employ at least one person.
personal.aushangpflichtige_gesetze|einma.erklaerung: Which laws must be displayed depends on your workforce. Amtlos compiles the list.

label.en: You employ at least one person.

personal.jugendarbeitsschutz|einmalig.kurz: For young people, an initial medical examination, working time limits and a notice posting obligation apply.

sanktion.text: The consequences have not yet been reviewed by experts.

personal.jugendarbeitsschutz|einmalig.erklaerung: If you employ young people, they need an initial medical examination beforehand, you must comply with special working time limits and you must post the Youth Employment Protection Act (Jugendarbeitsschutzgesetz).

sanktion.text: Without certified software, the notifications are not possible.

warum: You employ at least one person.
personal.lohnabrechnung|einmalig.erklaerung: The payroll itself is done by a system-certified partner; Amtlos provides master data and deadlines.

label.en: You employ at least one person.

personal.mindestlohn|einmalig.kurz: You pay all employees at least the statutory minimum wage.

sanktion.text: The consequences have not yet been reviewed by experts.

personal.mindestlohn|einmalig.erklaerung: The minimum wage is €13.90 per hour from 1.1.2026 and €14.60 from 1.1.2027. Amtlos keeps the values with their validity period.

label.en: You employ at least one person.

personal.minijob_grenze|einmalig.kurz: Mini-jobbers may not earn more per month than the mini-job limit: €603 (2026), €633 (2027).

sanktion.text: The consequences have not yet been reviewed by experts.

warum: You employ mini-jobbers.
personal.minijob_grenze|einmalig.erklaerung: The mini-job limit is linked to the minimum wage. Amtlos keeps the values with their validity period.

label.en: You employ mini-jobbers.

personal.sv_jahresmeldung|einmalig.kurz: Once a year, an annual notification goes to the health insurance fund (Krankenkasse) for each employee.

sanktion.text: The consequences have not yet been reviewed by experts.

warum: You employ at least one person.
personal.sv_jahresmeldung|einmalig.erklaerung: The payroll software sends the annual notification (DEÜV) for everyone employed over the turn of the year.

label.en: You employ at least one person.

personal.umlagen_eau|einmalig.kurz: For employees, you pay levies (U1, U2, U3) and retrieve sick notes electronically.

sanktion.text: The consequences have not yet been reviewed by experts.

warum: You employ at least one person.
personal.umlagen_eau|einmalig.erklaerung: The levies fund reimbursement of continued pay during illness, maternity benefits and insolvency pay. You retrieve the eAU from the health insurance fund (Krankenkasse), usually via the payroll software.

begriffe.erklaerung: Electronic certificate of incapacity for work (sick note) that you retrieve from the health insurance fund.

label.en: You employ at least one person.

zu_klaeren: You sell electrical devices.
produkte.barrierefreiheit|einmalig.erklaerung: The BFSG lists the affected products exhaustively. Check whether your products are among them.

sanktion.text: The consequences have not yet been reviewed by experts.

produkte.batterien|einmalig.erklaerung: Battery manufacturers must register before placing products on the market.

produkte.geldwaesche_gueterhaendler|einm.titel: Anti-Money Laundering Act for large cash transactions

zu_klaeren: You sell goods.
You accept large cash payments for goods.
